serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: And how is it? Do you have any regrets about coming here?
You: I don’t think regret is a good word to describe it…
You: I still feel a little out of place, that’s all. 
Bot: I’m sure it will pass.
Bot: So, what do you think? Wanna build a sand castle or maybe play in the water?
You: Hmmm. How about we take a short walk around the beach first? 
Bot: Works for me!
I wonder what it is about me. I should be feeling happy. Only a small percentage of people can afford such a life and yet I do not feel content…
Is it a flaw in my character or maybe my body just cannot get accustomed to the warm climate after living my whole life in the cold? 
Who knows.
Coming back after all this struggle isn’t an option. I can’t disappoint all these people anyway.
Whatever is wrong with me, one thing I know for sure.
As long as I have {f_botName} by my side, it’s not that bad.
